messages.subject: Error: could not find function "choose.dir"
parts:
Hi,
I am trying to create an application in which one of its argument is a data path. So I used "choose.dir" function and it worked well when I used it on my system. But when I tried to deploy the app on shinyapps.io, it brings up an error message that it couldn't find choose.dir. Please what could be wrong? How can this problem be solved. Thanks!

Tunde

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Error: could not find function "choose.dir"
parts:
ShinyApps.io uses Ubuntu, and choose.dir() is not a function available
in R under Linux. Besides, you should avoid using such functions in
general that require human interaction and are only usable locally
(even if there is a choose.dir in R, you will not be able to pop up a
dialog box in the server environment and use it in the web browser).
Similar functions include winDialog(), file.choose(), choose.files(),
and so on.

Regards,
Yihui

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Error: could not find function "choose.dir"
parts:
I'm not sure if you want the user to upload a data file (in which case
you need the function shiny::fileInput()), or choose an existing path
under your app. If the latter, you may provide the possible paths in a
drop-down menu, e.g. using shiny::selectizeInput(..., choices =
list.files(recursive = TRUE)).

Regards,
Yihui
